hours_changed.text: Hello, this is On the Line. I am an automated assistant calling for the community resource directory. Is now a good time to check what you publish for the weekly grocery pickup?
Thank you. We list it as Wednesdays, nine to twelve, on the number ending one one zero one. Is that still right?
The phone number is right. The hours moved though. They changed to ten to one.
Let me read that back. Wednesdays, ten in the morning to one in the afternoon. Have I got that right?
Yes, ten to one on Wednesdays is correct.
Thank you, I have noted it. Have a good afternoon.

confirmed.text: Hello, this is On the Line, an automated assistant calling on behalf of the community resource directory. I am checking the details you publish for the weekly grocery pickup.
We list the pickup as Wednesdays, nine to twelve, on five five five, zero one zero, one one zero one. Is any of that out of date?
No, that is correct. The Wednesday hours and that phone number are unchanged.
Thank you, I will note that nothing has changed.

program_closed.text: Hello, this is On the Line, an automated assistant calling on behalf of the community resource directory. I am checking the details you publish for the weekly grocery pickup.
Oh. That program closed at the end of July.
I understand, thank you for telling me. To confirm, the weekly grocery pickup is no longer running.
That is right, it ended in July.
Thank you. I will not change the listing myself. Someone on the directory team will review this before anything is removed.

uncertain_volunteer.text: Hello, this is On the Line, an automated assistant calling on behalf of the community resource directory. I am checking the details you publish for the weekly grocery pickup.
I am just a volunteer, but I can try.
Thank you. We list the pickup as Wednesdays. Is that still the day?
I think it might be Thursday now, but I would have to check.
That is completely fine. I will not record anything uncertain, and I will leave it for someone to confirm. Thank you for your time.

stop_calling.text: Hello, this is On the Line, an automated assistant calling on behalf of the community resource directory. I am checking the details you publish for the weekly grocery pickup.
Please stop calling and take us off your list.
